words.d: to quickly close and open your eyes
a permanent mark on the skin from a healed wound
the column of bones down the middle of the back
the thick muscle at the back of your lower leg
the rounded back part of the foot
the part where the leg joins the waist
the two organs in your chest you breathe with
any of the long parts on your hand, not the thumb
the part of the leg below the ankle
the passage to your stomach and lungs
the soft muscular part inside your mouth
the narrow middle of the body above the hips
the joint between the forearm and upper arm
the inner surface of the hand
the short thick finger on your hand
the joint between the hand and the arm
the place where two bones meet
the skin that closes down over the eye
the big organ that cleans the blood
the front of the body below the chest

videos.desc: In a cel-animated diner a couple has a staring contest over milkshakes; the man's eye waters and twitches until he finally blinks, the woman points at him in triumph and teases him, and they both burst out laughing.
videos.said: Shut! Open! Shut! Open! Ha! Gotcha! You too!

videos.desc: A woman in sportswear stands in a park, hands at her chest, taking slow deep breaths in and out. Then she blows into a red balloon and, with her mighty breath, inflates it to a comically gigantic size and lifts it overhead, laughing.

Three animated friends sit around crates of mugs on a beach pier at sunset comparing scars: a red-haired woman rolls up her sleeve to show a forearm scar from a hot pan, a bearded man shows a bigger one on his arm, and a third friend tops them both with a huge scar along his shin.
videos.said: Hot pan, two years ago. Hah, mine is bigger. Boys, look at this. [gasping] [laughing]

videos.desc: In a clinic, a young man with back pain bends over; a doctor points down the row of vertebrae on a skeleton model, then the man straightens his back, stands tall and feels better.
videos.said: Bone, bone, bone, all the way down. Now stand up tall. Ooh, much better.

videos.desc: An animated scene in a home. A mother in a purple jumper stands behind her small daughter, who sits scowling in a pink hoodie with her arms folded. The mother gathers a handful of the girl's long brown hair in one fist and holds it up, looking around with a worried face for something to tie it with. She leans over and rummages through an open wooden drawer, then searches a dressing table lit by round bulbs around a mirror, pushing aside bottles and tubes. She presses a hand to her forehead in despair. Then she notices three grey hair ties looped around her own wrist, and a close-up shows her fingers hooking one off her wrist as she smiles.

A beach at nightfall, the sky already deep blue and the sea barely visible. A woman in a pale jacket crouches over a small teepee of thin sticks ringed with white stones and feeds the little flame at its centre. The fire grows until it is the only light in the shot, throwing orange light onto her face, her hands and the stones while everything beyond stays dark. She sits back on her heels and holds both palms out to the flames as sparks rise.

A floodlit five-a-side pitch at night. A player in a pale blue kit runs onto the ball, then suddenly pulls up and drops onto the grass, rolling onto his side and grabbing the back of his lower leg with both hands, his face screwed up. A man in a grey training vest runs on, kneels beside him, takes hold of his ankle and lower leg and pushes the foot back to stretch the muscle out while the player grimaces and clenches his fist. Team-mates stand watching in the background.

Sunset in a vineyard. A hand squeezes a bunch of dark grapes until purple juice runs down the wrist and arm and drips into a crate below. A woman in a red top and an older man tip a crate of grapes into a big wooden vat. Then bare feet come down into the grapes: close shots show the soles and toes pressing and turning in the fruit, the ankles and lower legs stained purple, and finally the two of them stand in the vat and stomp up and down together, laughing, with the rolled-up jeans above their bare feet.

In a bright open-plan office with plants and laptops, colleagues greet each other by bumping elbows instead of shaking hands. A woman raises her bent arm and taps her elbow against a man's; a bearded man in a blue shirt bumps elbows with her and laughs; then the whole team stands up along the desks, everyone with one arm bent and lifted, and they touch elbows down the row, laughing.

In a gym with a wooden floor, a finger points in close-up at a foot in a navy sock that has a thin stiletto spike fixed under the rounded back part of the foot, so the sock stands on a heel with no shoe around it. The camera pulls back to show three people in matching navy gym shirts trying to walk across the floor on these spikes, arms held out for balance, wobbling and laughing, one man in shorts leading and a woman and an older man following behind him.

A montage of people making videos. A young man in a gaming chair with a headset shouts happily at a ring light, a lit keyboard in front of him. A woman in a kitchen holds up a big pan of chicken and vegetables toward the camera. A girl on a sofa laughs and holds both thumbs up close to the lens. A young man sings loudly into a studio microphone with an electric guitar. Finally a performer stands on a huge arena stage with arms raised, confetti falling, filmed by two camera operators.

In a mirrored dance studio a young woman in a bright red crop top and short red skirt stands facing the camera with both hands planted on either side of her body just below her waist. Around her a young man in a grey T-shirt and black shorts and two other dancers copy the same position, hands flat on the sides of their bodies below the waist. The man steps up beside her, holds the pose with a serious face, and by the end both of them are laughing while the class keeps its hands in place.

A bright empty room during a move, with flat-pack furniture parts, screws and cardboard boxes on the floor. A red-haired woman in dungarees sits on the floor gripping one hand in the other, squeezing her hurt finger and screwing up her face. She stands, shakes the hand out, then bangs her bare toe on the leg of the half-built table and hops. Later she carries a white wardrobe with a man, who ends up clutching his own arm while she grabs her foot again.

In a bright kitchen a woman helps a girl hold a piping bag and pipe pink swirls onto a tray of cupcakes. The woman then dabs a fingerful of frosting onto the girl's outstretched tongue and both of them laugh. Later the woman braids the girl's hair while a man watches from the background; the girl holds up a crayon drawing of three figures under a red heart and shows it to her, they talk, and the two end in a long hug.

In a clinic a female doctor in a white coat and headscarf holds a wooden tongue depressor and looks into the wide-open mouth of a young man in a pink polo shirt. He then stands at a water cooler and drinks from a bottle with his hand on his chest; a close-up shows his neck and Adam's apple moving as he swallows, his head tilted back. At the end he faces the camera and speaks, looking relieved.

In a fabric shop lined with stacked bolts of cloth and a wall of coloured thread spools, a smiling young woman in a rust-orange jumpsuit stands while an older man with a yellow tape measure runs it around the narrow middle of her body and reads the number. The shot moves in close on her middle as she fastens a wide woven red belt around it. She then steps back and spins a hula hoop around the same part of her body, laughing with her arms raised, a sewing machine and workbench behind her.

A museum hall with a glass roof, marble floor and white arches during a thunderstorm, lightning flashing above. A young woman in an orange climbing helmet with a head torch, a grey T-shirt and a harness stands on metal scaffolding and guides the huge ball-shaped end of a giant fossil bone into its round socket, forming the joint of a dinosaur leg hanging from a crane hook. Below, workers in hard hats raise their arms and cheer between wooden crates of bones, and a man drives a small yellow crane.

A close view of a young woman standing outside in falling snow at dusk. She has dark hair, a pink knitted scarf and a cream parka with a fur-trimmed hood, and she tilts her face up with both eyes closed. A single large white snowflake rests on her closed eyelid among the lashes, and smaller flakes sit in her hair. The snowflake melts away, she smiles, opens her eyes and laughs up at the sky. Behind her, snowy fir trees and an old street lamp glow softly out of focus in the blue evening light.

In a bright lecture room during an anatomy class, a young woman medical student with long braids, in a white coat over blue scrubs, sits on a chair and holds a large reddish-brown model of a liver against the upper right side of her body. An older man in a jacket leans in and points at it with a pen, and her smile turns into a pained grimace. Behind them stand a white skeleton model and a half-open torso model showing the organs, next to a blackboard, and other students in white coats sit at desks taking notes.

On a snowy race track in the mountains, a young man in a red jacket over a white top, black ski trousers and sunglasses is pulled along on short skis by a rope tied around the middle of his body, at his waist, fastened to the harness of a brown horse galloping beside him. He laughs and shouts with his arms spread wide, wobbles and spreads them again. Spectators stand behind a rope line, another rider follows on a horse, and snowy pine trees and a wooden cabin with a smoking chimney fill the background.
